purpose: Check whether the 16-versus-22 electrode difference survives more training seeds, and describe accuracy as a function of electrode count
selection: All nine participants; channel subsets from the archived session-1 relevance order; no new selection and no change to the historical final configuration
same_subset_note: For these participants the redundancy-aware subset equals the relevance subset, so no separate model is trained; the analysis reuses the relevance runs.
primary: artifact-free session-2 trials; average seeds within participant, then the nine participants
claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the test results were known. Not a new prospective test and not a basis for re-selecting the frozen final configuration.
